name: March ARB
description: March ARB is a full-time Air Force Reserve installation in the Inland Empire, home of the 452nd Air Mobility Wing operating KC-135 and C-17 air refueling and airlift missions. Most services operate on a limited weekday schedule with expanded availability during Unit Training Assembly (UTA) weekends.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center — plan ahead for UTA weekends.

gates.name: Cactus Ave Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 visitor and military access gate. Day passes issued at the gate; extended visitor access processed at the Visitor Control Center in Bldg 2370. REAL ID required.
gates.address: Cactus Ave & Graeber St, March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

gates.name: Riverside Gate
gates.notes: Alternate gate for deliveries and DoD ID card holders 0600-1600 daily. Closed outside posted hours.
gates.address: Riverside Gate, March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

gates.name: Meyer Gate
gates.notes: Alternate gate for deliveries and DoD ID card holders 0600-1600 daily. Closed outside posted hours.
gates.address: Meyer Gate, March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 2370)
gates.notes: Visitor passes, DBIDS registration, and extended base access. Closed federal holidays and non-UTA Saturdays. REAL ID required.
gates.address: 363 Graeber St, Bldg 2370, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Back Street Grill
resources.description: Primary on-base dining — not a traditional DFAC. Serves breakfast and lunch on duty days with dinner added on UTA weekends. Starbucks espresso station, salad bar, and Cirrus meeting room (reservations via main line). Expanded UTA weekend meal service for reservists.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0630-1000, Lunch 1100-1330; UTA weekends: Breakfast 0530-0900, Lunch 1100-1330, Dinner Sat 1600-2000; Starbucks Mon-Fri 0630-1500, UTA Sat-Sun 0600-1500
resources.address: 870 Adams Ave, Bldg 110, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Hap Arnold Club
resources.description: Officer and enlisted club with Ace's Sports Bar, Sally's Alley, and catering services. Hours vary by event and UTA schedule — call ahead on non-drill weekdays when staffing may be limited.
resources.hours: Event-based schedule; call 951-653-2121 — expanded UTA weekend hours
resources.address: 870 Adams Ave, Bldg 110, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: March ARB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: March ARB Main Exchange with clothing, electronics, barber shop, beauty shop, and retail services.
resources.address: 23640 N St, Bldg 758, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: March ARB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery with deli, bakery, and CLICK2GO curbside pickup. One of the few reserve installations with an on-base commissary — open most days with early-bird entry for eligible patrons.
resources.hours: Sun-Mon 1000-1830; Tue-Wed-Fri 0900-1830; Thu 0900-2000; Sat 0800-1830; Early bird Mon-Fri 0700-0900 (eligible patrons)
resources.address: 15150 6th St, Bldg 1000, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: 452nd Medical Group
resources.description: Reserve medical group supporting 452nd AMW — flight medicine, immunizations, and readiness for reservists. Limited ambulatory clinic hours; no emergency department on base. Use civilian ER for emergencies.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; expanded UTA weekend sick call as posted
resources.address: 2050 Graeber St, Ste 458, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: TRICARE / Off-Base Medical Care
resources.description: Reserve beneficiaries should establish care with TRICARE network providers in the Moreno Valley, Riverside, and San Bernardino area. Nearest full MTF is David Grant Medical Center at Travis AFB for referrals as directed.
resources.hours: Provider-specific hours; TRICARE Nurse Advice Line 24/7 at 800-874-2273
resources.address: March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

resources.name: March ARB Fitness Center
resources.description: Cardio, weight training, group exercise, and intramural sports. Reservations required via online booking system — not 24/7 open access. Reserve base with reduced weekend hours outside UTA.
resources.address: 1980 Dekay Ave, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service for 452nd AMW personnel. Appointment-based during duty periods — plan finance actions around UTA weekends when walk-in support is expanded.
resources.address: Bldg 2314 area, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Off-Base Banking & Credit Unions
resources.description: No on-base FCU office at March ARB. Navy Federal, USAA partner ATMs, and area banks in Moreno Valley and Riverside.
resources.hours: Off-base institution hours; Navy Federal and area banks in Moreno Valley
resources.address: Moreno Valley and Riverside, CA

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Traditional reservists in-process on the Saturday of their first UTA at 0700. Appointment-based via RAPIDS — customer support expanded on UTA weekends.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0800-1200; all day UTA weekends; use RAPIDS for ID card appointments
resources.address: 1351 Graeber St, Bldg 2314, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Airman & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, TAP, financial readiness, newcomers briefing, employment assistance, and family programs for reservists and families. Key resource for reserve-specific PCS and drill support.
resources.address: 1261 Graeber St, Bldg 2313, Ste 1A, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: 452nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, lodging, and community events for the 452nd AMW reserve community. Services expand significantly during UTA drill weekends.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; expanded services during UTA weekends
resources.address: March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

resources.name: March Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: 435-room lodging facility and one of the busiest in the Air Force Reserve. Weekends often reserved for UTA and mission-essential groups — book early. Space-A available Sun-Thu; limited UTA weekend availability.
resources.address: 655 M St, Bldg 100 Ste 4, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Off-Base Housing Resources
resources.description: No on-base privatized family housing at this reserve installation — all family housing is off-base in Moreno Valley, Riverside, Perris, and surrounding Inland Empire communities. Contact M&FRC for relocation assistance.
resources.hours: Contact M&FRC Mon-Fri 0730-1630 for relocation assistance
resources.address: Moreno Valley, Riverside, and surrounding areas, CA

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rentals, camping gear, seasonal recreation programs, and adventure trips. Reserve base with limited weekday staffing — call ahead or visit during UTA weekends.
resources.address: 1870 Graeber St, Bldg 434, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Information, Tickets & Travel (ITT)
resources.description: Discounted theme park tickets, event tickets, travel planning, and leisure packages for military families and reservists. Located in the Hap Arnold Club complex.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri Mon-Fri 0730-1630; UTA weekend hours as posted
resources.address: 870 Adams Ave, Bldg 110, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Fam Camp / RV Storage
resources.description: RV and camper storage plus Fam Camp sites for authorized patrons. Reserve installation — availability and access coordinated through Outdoor Recreation.
resources.address: 1870 Graeber St, Bldg 434, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Local Golf (No On-Base Course)
resources.description: No golf course on March ARB. Area courses in Moreno Valley, Riverside, and Temecula serve the local military community — check ITT for possible discounted tickets.
resources.address: Inland Empire, CA

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes, DBIDS registration, and base access for sponsored guests. All visitors require a pass — REAL ID required. Closed federal holidays; open UTA Saturdays only (not regular Saturdays).
resources.address: 363 Graeber St, Bldg 2370, March ARB, CA 92518

resources.name: Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense, law enforcement, and gate operations for March ARB. Cactus Gate staffed 24/7; Riverside and Meyer gates open 0600-1600 daily.
resources.address: March ARB, Moreno Valley, CA 92518

events.title: Newcomers Briefing
events.address: 1261 Graeber St, Bldg 2313, March ARB, CA 92518
events.description: Orientation for incoming 452nd AMW personnel and families. Covers reserve-specific services, off-base housing, UTA reporting, and base access. Bring orders and ID cards.

events.title: Unit Training Assembly (UTA) Weekend
events.description: Monthly reserve drill weekend — expanded dining, MPF, VCC, fitness, and MWR services available. Traditional reservists report to MPF Bldg 2314 at 0700 on first UTA.

primaryAction.title: March ARB Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: 363 Graeber St, Bldg 2370, March ARB, CA 92518

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS or assignment orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement. Reserve personnel should confirm UTA reporting instructions with their gaining unit before arrival.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Traditional reservists report to MPF in Bldg 2314 on the Saturday of their first UTA at 0700. ARTs and civilian employees report to the Civilian Personnel Flight in the same building. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Airman & Family Readiness Center.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: No on-base family housing at March ARB — all housing is off-base in Moreno Valley, Riverside, and surrounding communities. Contact the M&FRC for relocation assistance. March Inn offers temporary lodging but weekends are often reserved for UTA — book early.

sections.title: Gate Access & Reserve Base Services
sections.body: Cactus Gate (Main) is open 24/7. Riverside and Meyer gates are daily 0600-1600. VCC in Bldg 2370 is Mon-Fri and UTA Sat 0700-1600. This is a reserve installation — no traditional DFAC (Back Street Grill serves meals on duty days and UTA weekends), fitness requires reservations at startbooking.me/452fitness, and most support offices have limited weekday hours with expanded UTA availability.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource for reserve relocation support.
